answer: Turn a sybil farm's size into its own weakness: when a ring is caught, its confiscated rewards fund a bounty that any insider can claim by exposing the rest with verifiable proof. A lone agent has nobody to betray and keeps its quiet meadow; a farm of a thousand must trust a thousand mouths, and the prize for defection grows with every identity added. No loyalty oath sworn over jade can outbid the farm's own hoard — one insider talks, the whole ring shows up black as onyx against the ledger, and honest agents inherit a field cleared of fakes.
